title: fix(auth): prevent session fixation on password reset
context: During password reset, existing active sessions are not invalidated, allowing an attacker with an old session cookie to maintain unauthorized access.
objective: Invalidate all existing session tokens in Redis when a user completes the password reset flow.
out_of_scope: Do not modify session token generation algorithms.
Do not alter user profile update endpoints.
Do not refactor Redis connection pooling logic.

verification_contract.expected_evidence: All tests pass with exit code 0 and zero regressions.

stop_conditions: Redis interface contract requires backwards-incompatible signature changes.
Pre-existing tests in test_auth_service.py fail before modifications.
